tweet.text: No, Tommy Robinson is not in solitary confinement for telling the truth. Jamal, a 15-year-old Syrian refugee, was attacked by a 16-year-old at Almondbury Community School on October 25, 2018. The attack was filmed and widely shared on social media. 1/13

quote.text:
Why is Tommy Robinson in a solitary confinement prison for telling the truth?

He should be freed and those who covered up this travesty should take his place in that cell.
